summary: This is a bash function that converts text to uppercase. It uses the `tr` command, a standard Unix tool that translates characters from one set to another, to swap all lowercase letters for their uppercase equivalents.

explanations.30: `tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'` reads from standard input (the piped text) and replaces every character in the lowercase set with the corresponding character in the uppercase set, then outputs the result.
